requirements.text: A user-friendly interface for customers to easily book appointments
Automated reminders sent via text or email before appointments
Immediate confirmation sent to customers after booking
Ability for customers to choose from basic services, including haircuts and grooming services
Functionality for customers to cancel or reschedule appointments through the system with just a few clicks
Customers should be able to view their upcoming appointments
The system must be simple and budget-friendly
The system must handle customer data securely
